title: Thousands of supermarket fridges still exposed after cyberattack
content: No group has claimed the attack, and experts warn thousands of similarly exposed devices remain online as a separate incident disrupts Dutch grocer Albert Heijn.

title: Croatia's wartime grievances threaten Montenegro's hopes of joining EU by 2028

title: Rutte urges allies to send more air defence to Ukraine
content: NATO Secretary General, Mark Rutte said allies need to do more to support Ukraine, especially in air defences. His pleas come amid drastic Russian escalation over the skies in Kyiv.

title: Violence in Paris as tens of thousands turn out for student protests across France

title: ‘Act five’: National Assembly opens budget debate amid ongoing student protests in France
